## What changes for consumers?

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## How was it checked?

List the commands or reproductions you ran and any checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and release notes

Identify affected languages, breaking changes, generated-contract updates, and the changelog entry. If the backend contract changed, state its source revision and intended deployment. Remove credentials and private data from all examples and logs.

## SDK documentation

For public API, behavior, model, option/default, or runtime changes, regenerate the affected SDK references and update the matching language guides in the docs site. Link the companion docs change or include proposed guide edits for a maintainer to apply. Record source-comparison and docs build results; explain an internal-only/no-guide-change assessment when applicable. Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/documentation.md` before marking this complete.
